description:
SweetFleet is a utility mod that makes fleet management less of a chore: multi-criteria sorting with editable presets, a logistics/affordability screen, officer-to-ship fit suggestions, and Fleet-tab buttons so you can reach it without leaving the screen.
Disclaimer: This mod was developed with heavy use of Cursor Auto mode (AI coding agents). I directed the design and tested in-game; the implementation was largely produced by those models. Treat it accordingly - please report bugs with a starsector.log if something breaks.
Compatible with: Starsector 0.98a (built against 0.98a-RC8)
Category: Utility / QoL
Save-safe: Yes - add or remove mid-campaign
Download: SweetFleet-0.5.7.zip
Source / releases: github.com/daerogami/sweet-fleet
Requirements

LazyLib (required)
Console Commands (optional) - for the sweetfleetsort command

Screenshots

Fleet tab %u2014 SF Sort / SF Settings in the controls column

Sort presets editor (SF Settings)

Sort confirmation on the campaign map

Logistics / affordability analysis

Officer fit %u2014 suggested reassignment

Officer fit %u2014 already optimal

Features

Multi-criteria sorting - order by a chain of properties (e.g. hull size, then value), not one column
Editable sort presets - create, rename, and reorder presets in SF Settings; selecting a preset makes it active for SF Sort and the hotkey. Presets are global (outside saves / the mod folder) and survive updates
Logistics & affordability analysis - per-ship supply/fuel/value, monthly report income, trailing income history, overreach flags, Efficiency Overhaul hints
Officer-fit suggestions - heuristic skill<-->hull matching, including the commander, with optional apply
Fleet-tab buttons - SF Sort and SF Settings in the fleet controls column; hotkeys still work if you disable the overlay

Usage

F8 - sort with the active preset
F7 - analysis dialog (campaign map; not from an open Core UI tab)
Console: sweetfleetsort, sweetfleetsort analyze, sweetfleetsort settings, sweetfleetsort help

Sort properties: hull size, value, supplies/month, fuel/LY, deployment points, combat readiness, hull integrity, D-mod count, officer assigned, mothballed, ship name.
Config: data/config/sweetfleet/config.json
Presets: Starsector/saves/common/sweetfleet-presets.data
Version Checker / TriOS update tracking is supported.

Changelog (0.5.7)

Added civilian hull sorting parameter
Changed the default sort preset to a more thorough chain

Earlier 0.5.x highlights
Changelog (0.5.6)
Fixed a crash when opening officer-fit suggestions
Fixed a crash in cost analysis when a ship was flagged for hull value
Fixed SF Sort / SF Settings hover flicker
Preset names with a percent sign are cleaned to avoid display errors

Changelog (before 0.5.6)
0.5.5 - Fixed Fleet-tab crash when dragging a ship with the SweetFleet buttons shown
0.5.4 - Selecting a preset makes it active immediately; commander included in officer fit
0.5.3 - More sort keys; one row per property with both directions
0.5.0 - Global editable presets and in-game editor
0.4.0 - Initial sort / analysis / officer fit / Fleet-tab buttons

Feedback and bug reports welcome. Please include starsector.log for crashes.

discordPostHtml:
SweetFleet is a utility QoL mod: multi-criteria fleet sorting with editable global presets, a logistics/affordability screen (overreach flags + Efficiency Overhaul hints), officer-fit suggestions (including your commander), and SF Sort / SF Settings on the Fleet tab. Hotkeys F8 (sort) / F7 (analyze). Requires LazyLib; Console Commands optional.
Developed with heavy use of Cursor Auto mode (AI coding agents) — I directed design and tested in-game; report bugs with starsector.log.

Changelog:
0.5.7
Added - civilian hull sorting parameter
Changed - the default sort preset is now a more thorough chain
0.5.6
Added - First public release (sort presets, analysis, officer fit, Fleet-tab buttons)
Fixed - Officer-fit / cost-analysis crashes, Fleet-tab drag crash, button hover flicker
Save Compatibility Notice
Safe to add or remove mid-campaign. Sort presets live in saves/common and survive mod updates.

Download: https://github.com/daerogami/sweet-fleet/releases/download/0.5.7/SweetFleet-0.5.7.zip
Forum Thread: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=35839

gallery.aiCaption: A stylized rendering of a teal spaceship shaped like a popsicle with a bite taken out of it.
The 'Sort presets' menu showing various sorting options like 'Hull size, then value' and 'Mothballed, Hull Size, Fuel Use'.
A game screen displaying the text 'SweetFleet: sorted 5 ships (Hull size, then value)' above the fleet status bar.
A logistics analysis screen listing 'Ships by supply upkeep' with details on supplies, fuel, and value for ships like ISS Azimuth and ISS Interstellaration.
An 'Officer fit suggestions' screen proposing an assignment for Farley Horn to the ISS Interstellaration.
An 'Officer fit suggestions' screen indicating that Farley Horn is already on the ISS Azimuth.
